full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance-style oil portrait places an older white-bearded man beside a brown bird of prey against a dark warm background. The man occupies the left and center, shown from the shoulders upward in right-facing three-quarter profile. A broad dark cap forms a heavy arc above his gray hair and shades the forehead, while his eye looks toward the upper right with a measured, thoughtful expression. Warm light touches the ear, cheek, nose bridge, and brow before easing into the shadow of the hat. His long white beard and mustache create a bright flowing mass over a deep burgundy garment, with individual pale strands softly visible but not sharply separated. The garment falls into the lower left in broad folds, its wine-red highlights almost swallowed by the surrounding brown-black values. Immediately to his right, the bird's head and upper chest rise close to his shoulder. Its rounded amber-brown eye, hooked pale beak, and overlapping tawny feathers are visible, while the body disappears beyond the lower right edge. The two profiles point in the same general direction, forming a quiet paired gaze and a compact arrangement of human skin, white beard, and brown plumage. The background remains a plain dark umber field, with no readable setting or objects; it deepens toward the edges and lets the lit forms come forward. Paint is blended across skin and shadow, while shorter strokes give the beard and feathers a softer tactile texture. A warm, directional light from the upper left reveals raised surfaces and leaves the cap, garment, and recesses in deep shade, without a visible cast shadow on the background. The overall composition is solemn and concentrated, balancing the luminous beard and face against a richly dark field and the bird's smaller alert profile.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形文艺复兴风格油画肖像把一名白须长者与一只棕色猛禽置于深暖色背景前。男子占据左侧和中央，以肩部以上的朝右四分之三侧影呈现。宽阔深帽在灰发上形成沉重弧线，并遮住额头；眼睛朝右上望去，神情审慎而沉思。暖光落在耳、面颊、鼻梁和眉弓上，随后渐入帽檐阴影。长白胡须和八字胡在深酒红衣服上形成明亮、流动的大块，浅色单根毛发柔和可见，却并非尖锐分离。衣服以宽褶垂向左下，酒红亮痕几乎被周围棕黑明度吞没。紧靠右侧，鸟的头和上胸在男子肩旁升起。它的琥珀棕圆眼、浅色钩喙和层叠黄褐羽毛可见，身体则延伸出右下画边。两道侧影大体朝同一方向，形成安静的共同凝视及人类肌肤、白须、棕羽紧凑排列。背景保持素净深褐色域，没有可读的场景或物件；向边缘加深，使受光形体前突。皮肤和阴影的颜料融合柔和，较短笔触让胡须和羽毛有较软、可触的肌理。来自左上的暖方向光显露隆起表面，帽子、衣服及凹处留在深影中，背景上没有可见投影。整体构图庄重且集中，以发亮白须和面容平衡浓暗背景及鸟较小而警觉的侧影。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting uses deep warm chiaroscuro, with small amber-lit forms emerging from a broad umber and near-black field. Softly blended transitions shape rounded areas, while shorter directional strokes describe fine fibrous textures. Burgundy, tawny brown, cream, and muted gold remain close in warmth, and the palest region is concentrated near the focal center rather than spread evenly. A heavy dark arc presses down from above, giving the lighter forms a compact, protected space. Edges are clearest at lit profiles and dissolve into shadow around the perimeter. Upper-side light grazes raised planes and leaves deep recesses without hard background projection. The overall treatment is restrained, solemn, and richly tactile, with tonal contrast carrying more force than elaborate setting.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅油画采用深暖色明暗对照，少量琥珀色受光形体从宽阔深褐和近黑色域中浮现。柔和融合的过渡塑造圆润区域，较短顺形笔触描绘细纤维肌理。酒红、黄褐、奶油色和低调金色在暖调上相近，最浅区域集中于焦点中央附近，而非均匀铺开。沉重深色弧形从上方压下，给较亮形体留出紧凑、受保护的空间。受光侧影边缘最清楚，向周缘则溶入阴影。偏上侧光擦过隆起平面，让凹处深暗，背景上没有硬投影。整体处理克制、庄重且可触，明暗对比比繁杂场景更有力量。
theme_en: An older bearded man in a dark cap beside a brown bird of prey
theme_zh: 一名戴深帽的白须长者与一只棕色猛禽并肩
name: Titian
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
